say:2:1534431001:0.text: Show some Wildborn spirit! Stop cowering in the deepest bushes!
say:2:1534431001:0.source_cn: 拿出点雅库伯尔的气概来！别哆哆嗦嗦地躲在树丛最里面！

say:6:1534431003:0.text: Says the one burrowing deeper into the shrubs...
say:6:1534431003:0.source_cn: 明明自己怕得要死，拼命往树丛里躲……

say:8:1534431004:0.text: Wait... if the horror stories are right, we should already be in the realm of the dead. Next, we perform a ritual and we'll be teleported back to camp...
say:8:1534431004:0.source_cn: 不对啊，按照恐怖故事的记录，我们应该已经进入死人的世界...

say:9:1534431005:0.text: What are you even talking about?

say:10:1534431006:0.text: It's not nonsense! I remember the Society article perfectly—volume three, page eighteen, line six...
say:10:1534431006:0.source_cn: 我没乱说，协会里的一篇文章我都记得很清楚！在第三篇第十...

say:11:1534431007:0.text: Stop!!! Reality check: we've wandered into the Primal Shrine. What do we do now?
say:11:1534431007:0.source_cn: 停！！！事实上现在我们跑到狩猎神殿了，你们说该怎么办？

say:12:1534431008:0.text: C-could we... be cursed? Ahh!! I don't want to die...
say:12:1534431008:0.source_cn: 难……难道是，诅咒……什么的……啊啊啊！不要，我不想死……

say:13:1534431009:1.text: Why did I even come with you...?
say:13:1534431009:1.source_cn: 我到底为什么要陪你们过来……

choice_prompt:16:1534431009.text: Why did I even come with you...?
choice_prompt:16:1534431009.source_cn: 我到底为什么要陪你们过来……

say:18:1534431010:1.text: W-who's talking?! Don't tell me... an actual ghost?! AHHH!
say:18:1534431010:1.source_cn: 谁、谁在说话！不会……不会真有鬼吧？啊啊啊——

say:19:1534431012:2.text: Chill out! He's clearly just a person!
say:19:1534431012:2.male: Chill out! He's clearly just a person!
say:19:1534431012:2.female: Chill out! She's clearly just a person!

say:21:1534431013:0.text: Hello. We're from the Midnight Fright Club. We came to verify some spooky stories and... well, we got a bit turned around.
say:21:1534431013:0.source_cn: 你好，我们是恐怖爱好者协会的成员，本来是想出来验证一些...
say:21:1534431013:0.male: Hello. We're from the Midnight Fright Club. We came to verify some spooky stories and... well, we got a bit turned around.
say:21:1534431013:0.female: Hello. We're from the Midnight Fright Club. We came to verify some spooky stories and... well, we got a bit turned around.

say:22:1534431014:0.text: Could you <style="highlight">lead us out</style>? It's late, we've got no fire, and we're worried about stumbling into a bog.
say:22:1534431014:0.source_cn: 请问你能不能<style=highlight>带我们出...
say:22:1534431014:0.male: Could you <style="highlight">lead us out</style>? It's late, we've got no fire, and we're worried about stumbling into a bog.
say:22:1534431014:0.female: Could you <style="highlight">lead us out</style>? It's late, we've got no fire, and we're worried about stumbling into a bog.

choice_prompt:23:1534431009.text: Why did I even come with you...?
choice_prompt:23:1534431009.source_cn: 我到底为什么要陪你们过来……

say:24:1534431015:0.text: Thank you! Hale, get up! Stop your shaking!
say:24:1534431015:0.source_cn: 谢谢！壮，你赶紧起来，不要发抖了。
say:24:1534431015:0.male: Thank you! Hale, get up! Stop your shaking!
say:24:1534431015:0.female: Thank you! Hale, get up! Stop your shaking!

say:26:1534431016:0.text: A ghost... there was a ghost...

narration:27:1534431017:0.text: You escort the trembling horror buffs back to camp...
narration:27:1534431017:0.source_cn: 你将这些瑟瑟发抖的恐怖爱好者们送回了营地……

say:30:1534431011:1.text: A ghost touched me! Its ectoplasmic hand was... surprisingly gentle? AHHH!

choice:16:1:2.text: (Tap one of them on the shoulder)
choice:16:1:2.male: (Tap one of them on the shoulder)
choice:16:1:2.female: (Tap one of them on the shoulder)
